purpose: Side view low tube frame central hopper rear pivot raised by actuator to dump over bin lip
code_or_query:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt; plt.xkcd(); fig, ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8,5)); ax.set_aspect('equal'); ax.axis('off'); ax.set_xlim(0,10); ax.set_ylim(0,6)
ax.plot([0,10],[0.5,0.5],'k-',lw=2)
ax.text(0.2,0.15,'ground')
from matplotlib.patches import Circle, Rectangle
for x in [2,7]:
  ax.add_patch(Circle((x,1.2),0.7,fill=False,lw=2)); ax.text(x-0.3,1.05,'wheel')
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((1.5,1.9),6.2,0.3,fill=False,lw=2)); ax.text(3.2,2.3,'tube frame')
ax.plot([1.5,7.7],[1.9,1.9],'k-',lw=3); ax.text(3.2,1.6,'belly pan')
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((3.0,2.3),3.2,1.0,fill=False,lw=2,linestyle='--')); ax.text(3.1,3.45,'hopper stowed')
ax.plot([6.2,6.8,5.2,4.6,6.2],[2.5,4.2,4.5,2.8,2.5],'r-',lw=2); ax.text(4.8,4.6,'hopper raised',color='r')
ax.plot([4.0,5.0],[2.2,3.2],'b-',lw=2); ax.text(2.6,2.8,'actuator',color='b')
ax.add_patch(Rectangle((7.8,0.5),1.5,2.5,fill=False,lw=2)); ax.text(7.85,3.15,'bin 1m lip')
ax.plot([6.8,7.8],[4.0,3.1],'r--',lw=1); ax.text(6.7,3.7,'flow',color='r')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig('sketch.png',dpi=150)
